desc_en: Designed to stand out in every movement. This crop top combines a deep V-neckline with a racerback silhouette and a distinctive cutout detail. Crafted with a technical blend for a durable and comfortable fit. A versatile piece for training or daily wear. Made to order with worldwide shipping.

Confeccionado con una mezcla técnica para un ajuste cómodo y duradero. Una pieza versátil para entrenamiento o uso diario. Disponible bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
